response.user: Account public ID and profile snapshot

sdk.expiresAt: Same expiry as the voice Bearer

clientExchange.renewal: Exchange every 5 minutes while in a room or before resuming. The same source account session returns the same voice Bearer.

serverExchange.credentials: Independent ACCOUNT_VOICE_BRIDGE_SECRET held only by the two servers
serverExchange.signature: HMAC-SHA256(secret, UTF8(join([account-voice-v1, POST, path, timestamp, nonce, SHA256(rawBody)], newline))) as lowercase hex
serverExchange.nonce: Random 16-byte lowercase hex, durably consumed once

sessionBody.sourceExpiresAt: Unexpired account session expiry, at most 31 days
sessionBody.user: Profile snapshot; id and sdkUserID equal account public ID

deleteBody.accountID: Account public ID, never Apple subject

serverExchange.revocation: Account SQLite session-delete trigger persists an outbox in the same transaction. Immediate bounded HTTPS attempt and background retries. Voice tombstones prevent delayed session exchanges; tombstones last 32 days. Durable revocation precedes media cleanup retries.

avatarPolicy: Only https://kiki.group/v1/avatars/<64 lowercase hex>.jpg; no query, credentials, alternate host or scheme

modes.production: VOICE_AUTH_MODE=account refuses invitation login and pre-existing lab Bearers
modes.laboratory: VOICE_AUTH_MODE=lab requires separate invitation and refuses account bridge requests

migration: Maintenance cutover; no old room/user metadata migration. Room appearance is stored only as the room theme index (0...4).

roomAppearance.editing: PATCH /v1/rooms/{id} accepts theme and/or title for the room owner; status must be separate
roomAppearance.legacyRead: Unsupported historical theme values are presented as 0 without rewriting stored data
